text:
Every market is a yes/no question with an end date and a public source.

A YES share pays $1 if it happens. $0 if it doesn't. NO is the mirror image.

The price is the crowd's probability.

YES at 64¢ means the market thinks there's roughly a 64% chance. If you think it's higher, YES is cheap.
You don't have to wait for the end. Sell any time while the market is live, at whatever the price is then.

No order book, no waiting for someone to take the other side. An automated market maker (LMSR) always quotes a price.

Try it with free test tokens. Link in bio.
